messages:
zoe: quick follow-up from the console layout PR review. found a few accessibility nits during keyboard + SR testing: 1) focus outline on table rows is removed when row expands, 2) some inline action icons have no accessible name, 3) table pagination uses arrow keys but doesn't update an aria live region. screenshot/gif: https://assets.redwood/console/row-expand-focus.gif :mag: rahul: thanks. for 1) that's a regression from the accordion refactor. the expanded state adds a class that sets outline: none. we should never remove focus styles. mia: agree. prefer focus visible separate from expanded styling. suggestion: `.row.expanded:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 3px; } .row.expanded { background: var(--bg-elev); }` ensures selection vs focus are distinct. zoe: good. please ensure the focus color meets 3:1 against the expanded bg on both themes. rahul: noted. for 2) action icons: the delete/duplicate icons are `` with no aria-label. quick fix: add `aria-label="Delete model"` and `aria-label="Duplicate model"` or use visually hidden text inside the button. mia: avoid relying only on title attrs. some AT don't read them consistently. `aria-label` or `Delete model` inside the button is better. dev-bot: lint: button-icon components missing aria-label in 4 places. See: https://ci.redwood/lint/1779995555 rahul: for 3) pagination: we have arrow key handlers that change page, but no announcement. add a hidden live region like `
` and update text to "Page X of Y" when it changes. mia: small keyboard-flow note: when expanding a row into detail view, focus currently stays on the expand button. keyboard users expect focus to move into the expanded region (first focusable control) or the region header. which do we prefer? zoe: prefer moving focus into the expanded panel's first control. If the panel is non-interactive then focus the panel container with `tabindex=-1` and `role=region aria-label="Details for {model name}"`. that makes it discoverable for SR users. rahul: implemented a quick focus-trap for the expanded panel and added `aria-labelledby` pointing to the panel heading. still debating whether to trap focus for expanded rows vs full-screen modals. dev-bot: accessibility scan (axe) summary: 7 violations found - color-contrast (2), aria-label (3), focus-order (1), live-region (1). Full report: https://ci.redwood/axe/1779995555 mia: two microcopy suggestions: change icon-only tooltip text from just "Delete" to "Delete model: " (visible to SR via `aria-label`) and change "More" to "More actions" for buttons that open menus. small but clearer. zoe: also noticed the table header sort toggles don't set `aria-sort` properly. set `aria-sort="none"` initially and toggle to `ascending`/`descending` on click. add `aria-label` like `Sort by Name, currently descending`. rahul: will open 3 focused PRs: 1) focus outline fix + contrast check, 2) icon button aria-labels + microcopy, 3) pagination live region + aria-sort fixes. aiming to have WIP PRs by EOD. mia: i'll run VoiceOver and NVDA checks after PRs land and add a tiny e2e that asserts `#pagination-status` updates, and that expanded panel receives focus. zoe: action items recap: rahul: PRs for fixes; mia: SR passes + e2e; dev-bot: re-run axe after changes. I'll attach a checklist to INF-5022 and add screenshots for both themes. thanks all :sparkles:
